home.title: Eisenmann Family Minhagim
home.subtitle: The customs and traditions of our family
home.description: We are a Yekke family — Jews whose roots trace to the Netherlands and the German-Jewish tradition. This site preserves the minhagim (customs) unique to our family: how we pray, what we sing, and how we mark the moments of Jewish life.

entry.no_customs_body: Customs for this occasion will be added as they are collected from family members.

footer.tagline: Preserving the Eisenmann family minhagim for generations to come.
